get.description: Everything we know about one point: elevation, river flow, hazard depths, UK gauges.
Terrain window, hazard depth grids and forecast flood scenarios for the 3D view.
Soil moisture in four layers against its 2000-present range, and groundwater.
AI discharge forecast for days 1-7 at the point's river, with flood-map scenarios.

post.description: Plain-English explanation from Claude, using only numbers from FloodScope's tools.

get.description: Google Flood Hub gauges near the point (feature flag: needs a waitlist API key).
Prithvi water maps from Sentinel-2 that cover this point (made offline by the ML job).

Replay a storm: hourly rain on the ground over 1-7 days, simulated on the server.

The first request starts the job and returns status "running" with progress; ask
again (every few seconds) until it is "ok". Finished replays are kept on disk.
Binary parts of a finished replay (already gzip-compressed on disk).

method.title: Method
method.default: LSTM (NeuralHydrology) trained on Caravan basins. It forecasts flow as a ratio to the river's 1997-2010 mean, driven by ERA5 weather and soil for the past year and the ECMWF IFS forecast for the next 7 days at this point, plus GloFAS flow up to today. The ratio is scaled by this GloFAS cell's mean flow. The band is the 10th-90th percentile of errors on held-out basins.

scenario_basis.default: The river cell's forecast flow is converted to a return period with the fitted curve, then the two nearest JRC maps are blended in log return period. The same flood size is applied to the whole window, so tributaries may differ.

relative_wetness_pct.title: Relative Wetness Pct
relative_wetness_pct.description: Where the value sits between the driest and wettest of those days, 0-100. Not a true saturation: soil porosity is not known.
